title: 第23章 红茄果变异诞生灵植第24章 杀机
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地

“哥，关月姐跟你说啥了？”
沈鸢第一时间走出来，眼神带着警惕。
沈易皱眉道：“说是刘二狗在偷偷蹲点咱们家。”
“刘二狗不就是个地痞流氓吗，跟着冯有田整天偷鸡摸狗，咱村里好多人都被他们欺负过。”
沈坤走出来，一听这话，立即来火了：“大哥，他肯定是看着我们三兄妹年幼好欺负，准是想来找事的，咱们先把他给干了！”
“先别冲动，盯着他们的动静，看他们想干什么，这几天我们就暂时不出去了。”
沈易稳住弟弟的情绪，眼神冷冽。
有这么一个人在暗中窥伺，说不定外出黑山的时候就挨了对方的黑枪。
得先解决掉这个家伙，他们才能放心出去做事。
如果真有什么歹心，他沈易的屠刀也不是专杀猪的！
有了这桩子事，兄妹三人心思都重了不少，沉着一股气用力练功。
三天时间一晃而过。
中午时分。
沈鸢浑身筋肉滚烫，热气外溢，气血在经脉中奔腾，轰然冲破了下一道关卡。
气血境，二重！
“小妹终于也突破了。”
沈坤见状停下了蛮牛三式的修炼，喜道。
接连数天的妖兽肉滋补，他们的突破过程可谓是水到渠成，没有半点滞涩！
他和大哥在前两天便已经接连破境。

“这就是气血境二重么？感觉力气和体魄都提升了不少！”
沈鸢独自呢喃，感受着自身的变化，抬手猛然一掌挥出！
强劲的掌力顿时朝着面前大石呼啸落下！
嘭！
挪开手掌，只见石块已经裂开丝丝裂纹。
这随意的一掌，绝对不下千斤！
除了力气和体魄的提升外，凝练气血的上限也增加了不少。
回过神来，沈鸢看到院子里只有二哥，顿时问道：“大哥呢？”
“他在后院呢，已经很久没出来了。”
“难不成又是在使用天赋了？”
沈鸢不由一阵担忧。
大哥每次使用天赋，整个人看上去就像是精力被抽空了似的。
她生怕大哥已经晕过去了，连忙往后院跑去。
进入后院。
看到大哥正一脸喜色地盯着菜田里的一株红茄果，眼睛都不眨一下，沈鸢不禁愣了愣。
她轻步上前，“大哥，这棵红茄果有什么问题吗？”
“有大问题！”
沈易头也不回，语气中难掩一丝惊喜。
只见在他的注视下，红茄果上面悄然出现了几行由金线交织而成的小字。
【变异红茄果·一阶灵植】

【成熟周期：39%】
【功效：壮大气血】

"Brother, what did Sister Guan Yue tell you?"
Shen Yuan walked out immediately, with alert eyes.
Shen Yi frowned and said, "It's said that Liu Ergou is secretly staying at our house."
"Isn't Liu Ergou just a local gangster? He followed Feng Youtian all day long, and many people in our village were bullied by them."
Shen Kun came out, and when he heard this, he immediately became angry: "Brother, he must have seen that our three brothers and sisters are young and easy to bully, and he must be looking for trouble. Let's kill him first!"
"Don't be impulsive. Keep an eye on their movements and see what they want to do. We won't go out for the next few days."
Shen Yi calmed his brother's emotions, his eyes cold.
There is such a person watching in secret, and he might be shot by the other party when he goes out to Montenegro.
They have to get rid of this guy first before they can go out and do things with peace of mind.
If he really had any evil intentions, Shen Yi's butcher knife was not designed to kill pigs!
With this matter in mind, the three brothers and sisters felt a lot more serious and practiced hard with calmness.
Three days flew by.
At noon.
The muscles all over Shen Yuan's body were hot, the heat was overflowing, and the blood was rushing through his meridians, and he suddenly broke through the next level.
Qi and blood realm, second level!
"My little sister finally made a breakthrough."
Seeing this, Shen Kun stopped practicing the three styles of Man Niu and said happily.
After several days of supplementing with monster meat, their breakthrough process was a matter of course, without any sluggishness!
He and his eldest brother had broken through one after another in the past two days.
"Is this the second level of Qi and Blood Realm? I feel like my strength and physique have improved a lot!"
Shen Yuan murmured alone, feeling the changes in herself, and raised her hand and suddenly waved out!
The powerful palm force suddenly roared down towards the big rock in front of him!
Bang!
When he removed his palm, he saw that the stone had cracked and cracked.
This casual palm definitely weighs more than a thousand pounds!
In addition to the improvement in strength and physique, the upper limit of condensing qi and blood has also increased a lot.
After coming back to his senses, Shen Yuan saw that there was only the second brother in the yard, and immediately asked: "Where is the eldest brother?"
"He's in the backyard. He hasn't been out for a long time."
"Is it possible that you are using your talent again?"
Shen Yuan couldn't help but feel worried.
Every time the eldest brother uses his talent, he looks like his energy has been drained out.
She was afraid that her eldest brother had fainted, so she hurriedly ran to the backyard.
Enter the backyard.
Shen Yuan couldn't help but be stunned when she saw her eldest brother staring at a red eggplant plant in the vegetable field with a happy face without blinking.
She stepped forward lightly, "Brother, is there anything wrong with this red eggplant tree?"
"There's a big problem!"
Shen Yi didn't look back, unable to hide a hint of surprise in his tone.
Under his gaze, several lines of small characters made of gold threads appeared quietly on the red eggplant fruit.
[Mutated red eggplant fruit·First-order spiritual plant]
[Maturity cycle: 39%]
[Efficacy: Strengthen Qi and blood]
